decisions.text: seen: the plan's 'ng build' check is not an allowed command; I ran 'pnpm run build' and logged the difference in Execution Notes. Reverse: run 'npx ng build' yourself.
decisions.rec: Keep pnpm run build; difference is logged.

decisions.text: seen: scope-check --drift still prints 'REALITY: drift' because main has new commits since the plan snapshot; that is expected. I ran Step 0 by symbol and every symbol was ok.
decisions.why: Expected drift note, not a decision.

decisions.text: behaviour: fixtures for the morning-report tests are built at run time in a temp dir, because bugs/ is gitignored at any depth. The scope entry scripts/test/fixtures/qa-morning/** is unused. Reverse: add static fixture folders there.
decisions.rec: Keep run-time temp fixtures; drop unused scope entry.

decisions.text: behaviour: a failed 'git merge --ff-only' in the up step does not count as a failed step; only 'qa-up.ps1', 'code-qa', 'merge' and 'qa-down.ps1' exit codes are checked. The plan says QA continues on the current tree in that case. Reverse: add the git lines to STEPS in morning-report.mjs.
decisions.rec: Keep: ff-only failure is not a failed step.
decisions.why: Matches the plan's stated behaviour; reversible.

decisions.text: behaviour: with no UI-run row in INDEX.md, no new S1/S2 findings and QA on current code, the status is ATTENTION with Do now 'check why the UI run did not run'. The plan marks that row as ATTENTION but gives no Do now wording for it. Reverse: drop the 'else if (!ui)' branch in buildReport.
decisions.rec: Keep ATTENTION with the check-why wording unless you prefer another.
decisions.why: Sets what the morning report tells the owner.

decisions.text: behaviour: a night with no '.nightly.log' lines on the report date gives BLOCKED, 'the nightly tasks did not run'. The plan does not cover this case. Reverse: remove the nightLogEmpty branch.
decisions.rec: Keep BLOCKED when nightly log is empty.
decisions.why: New status rule changes the report users read.

decisions.text: behaviour: qa-nightly-down.ps1 logs the morning report's exit code but still exits with the qa-down exit code, so a report failure never fails the task. Reverse: exit with the report's code instead.
decisions.rec: Keep exit of qa-down but log the report failure.
decisions.why: Report failures stay silent to the task scheduler.

decisions.text: behaviour: morning-history.md has one line per date; rerunning the report for the same date replaces that line instead of appending a duplicate. Reverse: always append.
decisions.rec: Keep one line per date, replace on rerun.

decisions.text: behaviour: derived phoneNormalized from phone on the doc just before the schema check (the strict schema requires the field, so 'after validation' is impossible); an invalid phone still fails on the phone regex and a client-sent value is always overwritten — reverse: make phoneNormalized optional in client.schema.ts and derive after checkStoredDoc in generic.js POST/PUT
decisions.rec: Keep server-derived phoneNormalized before schema check.
decisions.why: Touches stored data shape for clients.

decisions.text: behaviour: server does not store the clientType default (checkStoredDoc validates only, it does not store parsed output), so a client posted without clientType is stored without it — reverse: add clientType: 'private' to the POST stamp for clients in generic.js
decisions.rec: Stamp clientType 'private' on POST so stored docs are consistent.
decisions.why: Stored data lacks a default field.

decisions.text: behaviour: clients carry no _masterId/_userModified on POST or PUT (new NO_LINEAGE set in generic.js shared with taxonomyTerms), because the strict schema rejects them and INV-2 says clients never carry _masterId — reverse: remove 'clients' from NO_LINEAGE and allow the two fields in clientSchema
decisions.rec: Keep clients without lineage fields per INV-2.

decisions.text: behaviour: advanced the plan's Snapshot line to origin/main HEAD after Step 0 passed, instead of leaving drift reported — reverse: restore Snapshot: 8d7997e5b732007392f50cc07f40b2aa430f37d6 in the plan file
decisions.rec: Restore the old Snapshot unless you want it advanced.
decisions.why: Hides drift the plan was meant to report.
